overlay_guide:
NOMADE GUIDE
Duplicate this scene before editing it.
Enable the Speed, Heart rate, Map and Weather sources to show examples or incoming measurements.
For the phone, choose a Xiaomi source, open Larix and enter the SRT address from the assistant.
The OBS Media Source listens at srt://:9001?mode=listener (UDP 9001).
obs_connection_error: OBS connection refused. Check that OBS is open, its WebSocket server is enabled under OBS > Tools > WebSocket Server Settings, it listens on 127.0.0.1 port 4455, and OBS_MDP contains the matching password. Otherwise run ./scripts/primum_initium.sh --diagnostic.
obs_host_local_only: For safety, the OBS host must stay local (127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1).
cli_help: Print the diagnostic report in the terminal.
diagnostic_error: The diagnostic could not be completed: {error}
title: Nomade - First start
intro: Start with this read-only report. Each line tells you what to check; actions that change the system require your confirmation.
step_launch: choose a platform and start streaming
guided_scene_confirm: Add the Nomade scenes and missing sources to the open OBS collection? A backup will be created before changes; existing sources will not be replaced.
guided_websocket_help: In OBS, open Tools > WebSocket Server Settings, enable the server, keep address 127.0.0.1 and port 4455, then enter the Nomade local password. Do not expose the server on Wi-Fi or mobile networks.
guided_scene_done: Template added: {added} item(s), kept {skipped} existing source(s). Backups: {backups}
guided_open_emissio: Emissio is open: choose a platform, save its key, then use the launch button.
after_obs: What next? Connect the camera or capture device, then open Larix on the phone. Copy one of the SRT addresses below into Larix; if the .local name fails, use the IP address. In OBS, enable the matching Xiaomi source.
network_info: Network: Raspberry Pi {ip}; gateway {passerelle}; local name {nom_local}; detected phone {telephone}. Enter {srt} in Larix.
network_cli: Network {interface}; Wi-Fi {ssid}; internet {internet}; Raspberry Pi IP: {ip}; gateway: {passerelle}; local name: {nom_local}; phone: {telephone}; SRT .local address: {srt_nom}; SRT IP address: {srt_ip}
check_obs-studio_missing: Install OBS with Browser Source using the assistant.
check_avahi-daemon_ok: Avahi is installed to announce the Raspberry Pi local name.
check_avahi-daemon_missing: Install avahi-daemon to reach the Raspberry Pi by its local name.
check_avahi-utils_ok: The local name verification tool is installed.
check_avahi-utils_missing: Install avahi-utils to verify the local name announcement.
check_onboard_ok: The free Onboard virtual keyboard is installed.
check_obs_stopped: Open OBS before launching the Nomade interface.
check_websocket_ok: The OBS WebSocket server responds on 127.0.0.1:4455.
check_websocket_password: Check four items: OBS is open; obs-websocket is enabled; the address is 127.0.0.1 and the port 4455; OBS_MDP has the same password.
check_websocket_missing: Check four items: OBS is open; obs-websocket is enabled; the address is 127.0.0.1 and the port is 4455; OBS_MDP has the same password.
check_scenes_ok: The expected scene and source names were found.
check_scenes_missing: Import the OBS example, then adapt its scenes and sources to config/nomade.toml.
check_browser_ok: An OBS Browser Source is available.
check_browser_missing: Install the OBS build with Browser Source provided by this project.
check_mdns_ok: The Raspberry Pi local name responds from this device.
check_mdns_failed: The local name does not respond from the Raspberry Pi: check Avahi and its host name, then also try the IP address on the phone.
check_mdns_unknown: Avahi is active, but the verification tool is missing; if the name fails on the phone, use the IP address.
check_bluetooth_missing: Enable or connect the Bluetooth controller if you use SensorCast.
check_bnep_ok: The bnep0 interface and Mosquitto are active.
check_bnep_missing: Bluetooth PAN or Mosquitto is inactive; this connection is only needed for sensors.
check_video_missing: Connect the USB capture device if you use one.
check_srt_listening: OBS is listening on UDP port 9001.
check_srt_missing: Check that the OBS Media Source listens at srt://:9001?mode=listener.
check_srt_caller: OBS cannot confirm the caller state for this source. Start Larix and check the source preview.
check_srt_received: OBS reports an SRT source playing; the phone is sending a stream.
check_srt_no_caller: No SRT caller is playing. Start Larix in caller mode and check the address and port.
check_audio_missing: No audio input was detected; connect a microphone or headset if needed.
confirm_install: Run package installation/repair? This may install OBS and requires administrator privileges.
no_config_change: The network information is already up to date in the local override.
config_saved: The local configuration was updated. Backup: {backup}
confirm_wifi: Disable dietpi-wifi-monitor.service? Try this only if you have repeated disconnects; the service will be stopped and disabled.
confirm_tablet: Install the free Onboard virtual keyboard and enable single-click in the file manager? The existing file will be backed up.
tablet_done: Touchscreen comfort is prepared. Virtual display settings depend on hardware and drivers; they are not changed automatically.
confirm_autostart: Show the diagnostic automatically whenever LXDE starts? You can disable this option with the same button.
scene_notice: These scenes are templates to adapt to your capture device and phone. Local OBS collections will be backed up before adding them.
scene_confirm: Add missing scenes and sources? Existing items will not be replaced. (y/N)
scene_done: Import complete: added {added} item(s), kept {skipped} existing source(s).
scene_error: Import failed: {error}. Check that OBS is open and WebSocket listens on 127.0.0.1:4455.
obs_existing: An OBS installation already exists. It will be replaced by the Pi-Apps version.
obs_replace_cancelled: OBS installation cancelled; no existing package was removed.
admin_missing: The pkexec tool for administrator approval is unavailable.
network_info: Network {interface} — Wi-Fi: {ssid} — IP: {ip} — internet: {internet} — local name: {nom_local} — gateway: {passerelle}
srt_name_label: SRT address using the local name (UDP 9001)
srt_ip_label: SRT address using the IP address (UDP 9001)
srt_phone_hint: If the name does not work on your phone (some brands cannot resolve it), use the address with numbers. The IP address may change after a restart.
network_disconnected: ⚠ Internet unavailable: use “Retry Wi-Fi discovery and connection”.
obs_launch_choice: Yes: launch OBS in preparation mode. No: launch the direct profile. Cancel: do nothing.
confirm_obs_first_run: Prevent OBS's automatic setup wizard from opening by marking its first run handled in global.ini? The existing file will be backed up before changes. OBS will then create its base collection; the Nomade template still needs importing from the assistant.
obs_already_running: OBS is already open; no second instance was started.
obs_password_prompt: Choose the password. Then enter the same password in OBS > Tools > WebSocket Server Settings.
obs_password_confirm: Save this password only in config/nomade.secrets, a local file ignored by Git and protected with mode 600? You must also enter it in OBS WebSocket settings.
obs_password_saved: OBS password saved locally. Backup: {backup}. Also verify the value entered in OBS.
obs_password_invalid: Enter a non-empty password without control characters.
obs_password_file_error: The local secrets file is invalid or unreadable. Check config/nomade.secrets.
wifi_connect: Enter the password for the selected network
wifi_country: Wi-Fi country code (two letters, for example FR)
wifi_ssid_missing: Choose a network or enter its name.
wifi_password_prompt: Enter the Wi-Fi password. It will not be displayed.
wifi_write_confirm: Add this network to the system file after creating a backup? The password is neither displayed nor stored in the repository.
wifi_written: Network added after backing up the previous configuration.
wifi_invalid: Check the network name, an 8–63 character key (or 64 hexadecimal characters), and a two-letter country code.
confirm_reconnect: Retry Wi-Fi using administrator privileges? Each step will be shown. The connection may briefly drop.
wifi_step_missing: skipped: this tool is not installed
tablet_status_pending: Touch setup needs confirmation (Onboard, tap, and display settings).
wifi_service_absent: No dietpi-wifi-monitor service was found. Check its name before acting.
confirm_wifi: Disable {service}? Only do this after confirming repeated disconnects.
confirm_watchdog_install: Install and enable the Wi-Fi watchdog? It will try reconnecting every minute. This option is disabled by default.
tablet_validate: Confirm that Onboard, single-click in PCManFM, and touch settings are ready, or that your hardware is not touch-enabled. This confirmation is required to continue.
next_missing: The next step is blocked. Check internet access, packages, OBS/WebSocket, scenes, and touch setup.
emissio_platform_error: The platform definition file is incomplete or invalid.
emissio_profile_error: The configured OBS profile is not a valid profile name.
emissio_key_storage_warning: The key is stored in plain text in the local OBS profile (mode 600). Do not share a microSD card backup.
platform_help_twitch: Check Twitch documentation for the server and key for your selected region.
platform_help_kick: Check Kick documentation for the server and key.
platform_help_youtube: Check YouTube documentation for the recommended server and key.
platform_help_facebook: Check Facebook Live documentation for the server and key.
platform_help_velora: Check Velora documentation for the server and key.
platform_help_restream: Check Restream.io documentation for the server and key. This profile sends one stream to Restream for redistribution.
platform_help_custom: Enter the platform settings; verify the server in its documentation.
emissio_invalid: Invalid address. Check the server and protocol in the platform documentation.
emissio_srt_test: An SRT test without starting a stream is unavailable; Nomade will not start a test stream.
emissio_srt_saved: SRT settings saved in the protected local file. Then configure SRT output manually in OBS. Backup: {backup}.
emissio_srt_direct: The OBS service profile does not configure SRT output. Have you manually configured and checked SRT output in OBS? You must do this before continuing.
emissio_credentials_required: Enter a server and key, then save the OBS service before starting the stream.
emissio_save_confirm: Save the server and key to the local OBS profile before starting?
emissio_replace_profile: A profile for this platform already exists. Replace its server and key after creating a backup? The key remains in plain text in the local OBS profile file.
emissio_reachable: The server responds on the network. This does not guarantee the key will be accepted.
emissio_unreachable: The server did not respond. Check the address, network, and firewall.
emissio_save_error: Could not save settings or launch OBS: {error}
emissio_close_obs: OBS is already open in preparation mode. Save your scenes, close OBS, then restart direct mode from Emissio.
